name: Bitcoin
description: Bitcoin is a decentralized cryptocurrency originally described in a 2008 whitepaper. It is a peer-to-peer online currency, meaning that all transactions happen directly between equal, independent network participants without the need for an intermediary.

name: Apple Inc.
description: Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories worldwide. It is one of the largest technology companies by revenue and market capitalization.

name: Tesla, Inc.
description: Tesla, Inc. designs, develops, manufactures, leases, and sells electric vehicles, energy generation, and storage systems in the United States, China, and internationally. The company is a major player in the transition to sustainable energy.

name: NVIDIA Corp.
description: NVIDIA Corporation provides graphics, and compute and networking solutions. It is the dominant designer of advanced graphics processing units (GPUs) required for artificial intelligence, deep learning, and high-performance computing.
